name: id
description: Unique receipt identifier (hashed). Links one payment to one disbursement attempt.

name: amount_charged
description: Principal sent, in USD, excluding fee. payment amount = amount_charged + fee.

name: fee
description: Fee charged to the sender, in USD.

name: exchange_rate
description: FX rate applied from USD to destination_currency (1 when destination is USD).

name: promotion_amount
description: Promotional bonus in USD added to the amount delivered (destination_amount = (amount_charged + promotion_amount) * exchange_rate). Not charged to the sender.

name: destination_amount
description: Amount the beneficiary receives, in destination_currency.

name: payment_id
description: Foreign key to payments.id. A payment can have several receipts when a payout is retried.

name: disbursement_id
description: Foreign key to disbursements.id. Unique per receipt.

name: beneficiary_id
description: Recipient identifier (hashed). Each beneficiary_id appears under a single user_id.

name: created_at
description: Timestamp when the receipt was created (UTC).
